chapter: Imperial Orchestra and Southern Rhythm Boys
title: Her early marriage that lasted two months
summary: She married very young, refuses to name him, left after two months at about 16 and started traveling with a band afterwards.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: So she was just -- it was just the idea of because I was so very young at the time, and -- but as the time went on, of course, I really didn't leave Louisiana right away. I was still in school. I was still in school, but I didn't leave Louisiana right away. I did marry when I was very young, and I'm not going to even give the name of the gentleman that I married at that time. I was very young and he -- I felt that I was taken advantage of in a way, and I don't even want to
go into that. But nevertheless, that marriage lasted two months and I went back home.

Oh, I was about 16. And I went back home. And when I went back home, this is really when I started travelling. I did not start travelling before that time. What I mean travel, I mean the road, you know, like we went through Louisiana and Texas with this other group, with the Southern This was a bunch of Rhythm Boys, younger musicians, and some of them were from Texas, in fact three or four of them were from Texas. And we did go into Mississippi, Louisiana, Texas, you know, travelled around.
